sam (marketing): quick one for runtime— we need a compact bench run for the April launch post. deliverables: per-slice p50/p95/p99, cold vs warm breakdown, 30 anonymized long-context traces, and the exact command + image tag. also need sha256 of the requests file. deadline Thu EOD PT.

anya: got it. which model variant and quant? any pinned kernel?

sam (marketing): llama-13b-int8, qkv-fuse on, pin kernel tag `stable-2026-03`. warmup: replay 15% hotpath once, 8 warmups per worker. target p99 hotpath <700ms.

dev-runtime: reserving Fri 09:00-10:30 PT. we'll capture KV hit ratio, kernel selection, and per-request timings. we'll add `seed=1337` for reproducibility. runtime-bot will post the job link.

infra-bot: Job scheduled rjob-20260402-77. logs -> https://internal/runs/rjob-20260402-77.

claire: small note for marketing text: we'll attach a 2-sentence methods blurb (cohort selection + warmup + pinned build) and one anonymized long-context example. if hotpath p99 >700ms we'll include a short RCA and config used.

sam (marketing): perfect. include the curl snippet we can paste into the docs and the sha256 of the requests file. thanks! :thumbsup:
